subject: txn: fix the lock behaviours when for update is used when low resolution tso is used (#54738)
summary: Diff vs first parent updates locking-read eligibility and low-resolution-TSO gating: it centralizes lock applicability in `SessionVars.PessimisticLockEligible()`, hides the raw low-res flag behind `SessionVars.UseLowResolutionTSO()` (disabled for restricted SQL), and blocks executing locking reads (e.g. `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE/SHARE`) when low-res TSO is active and the lock would actually take effect. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor/planner/sessionctx behavior.
